input.label: P-H4
input.MO: saved real canonical RHF, no regenerated integrals

scientific_conditions.full_checks: Base kappa+c and each of R frames, plus Nalpha/Nbeta commutators; no full physical or XDF norm
scientific_conditions.kappa: h_original - 0.5 * einsum(prrq,g_original), held fixed after fit
scientific_conditions.constant: Original nuclear c at model level once; frame I terms stay inside frame
scientific_conditions.spatial_g_prefactor: No 1/2 applied at ffsim input; density J products carry 1/2
scientific_conditions.general_K: K[2i+sigma,2j+tau]=J[i,j]/2, V spin-lift U, one original frame preserved
scientific_conditions.spin_and_state_order: Interleaved spin mode a=2p+sigma, common matrix mode a on bit a; reverse OpenFermion/PhysicalSector bits once
scientific_conditions.baseline: Saved actual rank10 XDF from same packet; original generation df_rank=None,df_tol=1e-8; no new decomposition or rehermitization
scientific_conditions.DF_errors: Separate spectral norms of P36(Hphys-HCDF)P36 and P36(Hphys-HXDF)P36, including c/kappa/two-body
scientific_conditions.Stage2_eligibility: Separate decision after Stage1 measurement; not automatic from representation PASS

allowance.scale: Absolute pre-cancellation coefficient/operator envelopes; no fit-result threshold tuning
allowance.structural_formula: sqrt(d) times the spectral-form allowance, using the actual diagnostic matrix dimension
allowance.sum_adjustment: Add 8*R to raw/candidate full-sum path; XDF path uses actual saved rank10
allowance.candidate_frame_scale: Sum over I/Z/ZZ coefficients of |coefficient| times product of b_a, b_a=1+2*(sum_p |V_pa|)^2
allowance.policy_decision: Retain user-adopted limited-pilot engineering allowance binary64_operation_scale_guard8_v1 without coefficient/threshold changes; not a rigorous certificate

references.physical: Original h/g/c, frozen unthresholded spin-lift, no-pruning OpenFermion term map and existing JW sparse evaluator, sector36
references.raw_CDF: Original export kappa/J/U/c and generic CAR bit action, independent density products; no adapter K/V/Z coefficients
references.candidate_K: Existing general-K adapter and I/Z/ZZ coefficients; independent OF bilinears evaluated on matrices
references.saved_XDF: Existing DFHamiltonian/PhysicalSector/df_linear_operator, 36 basis actions, explicit bit order mapping
references.norm: SciPy1.14.1 gesdd maximum singular value; no Hermitian projection
references.independence_limits: Shared numerical libraries and frozen inputs, separate assembly transformations; real Gaussian circuit convention remains Stage2

saved_fit.policy: Reuse original J/U/kappa/c once; keep old source/input/export identity separate from new evaluation source. Old grant/output/STOP remain immutable; old scientific FAIL is not waived.
saved_fit.numerical_load: After new approval only: existing load_export verifies six array member hashes/schema/finite values, including stored x/jac as integrity data; x/jac unused, no optimizer/objective/tensor residual recomputation

runtime.backend: Existing repaired CAR matmul, independent OF/K construction, saved XDF Python sector kernel

call_accounting.prefix_failure: Journal attempted prefix; no call extension or additional analysis after failed gate
call_accounting.parallel_jobs: 16 raw/K frame build jobs are journaled before executor.map; a first frame FAIL leaves later gates unexecuted while already submitted tasks are cleaned up
call_accounting.historical_calls: Old fit6 accounting units are provenance only, not new calls. Compared with old83+8R success path, remove6 fit-phase units; scientific definitions otherwise unchanged.
call_accounting.solver_internal_evaluations: No new nfev/njev/nit; old metadata retained without recomputation

validation_order: Byte/JSON preflight, separate original-fit and repaired-evaluation source identities, fresh explicit approval
Load physical/XDF whitelist once, saved export once; verify original input member hashes and constant ownership
Original kappa/J/U structure gates; saved XDF kappa gate
Existing physical/XDF sector matrix construction (including36 XDF basis actions), as in frozen pipeline; no physical DF error norm yet
Full256 frame0 through7 equality; STOP on first failure, no sector comparison or physical DF error norms after failure
Only after all full base/frame equality gates PASS: full Nalpha/Nbeta conservation, sector restriction and four sector Hermiticity gates
Sector36 raw CAR/K adapter equality, then separate physical-CDF and physical-XDF spectral norms (report only)
Save results and mandatory STOP; no Stage2/3

outputs.operator_format: 8+2R NPZ from existing evaluation sink; no extra computation for saving
outputs.failure_file: failure.json; preserve raw partial outputs, no overwrite or resume

approval_and_STOP.failure_actions: Save prefix ledger, available operators/metadata and STOP. Never refit, retune rank/tol/precision/allowance, reuse grant, resume or add uncontracted analyses.
approval_and_STOP.interruptions: SIGINT/SIGTERM or errors leave partial STOP where Python cleanup is possible. No child fitter exists; already submitted executor work may be joined. Abrupt kill requires evidence reconciliation, not resume.
approval_and_STOP.on_success: Report all gates and separate physical CDF/XDF errors, then mandatory STOP

resources.configuration: Read actual available CPU/pressure/RAM before approved run; pair independent frames across min(R,available affinity) workers with floor(available/workers) BLAS threads, no arbitrary core cap
resources.memory: Cache immutable CAR bilinears, stream frame outputs; aggregate RAM check across workers
resources.GPU: Driver unavailable at technical check; CPU path qualified on artificial data
resources.noninterference: Only task-owned venv/cache/output/process group; no shared server/package/cache or other-user changes

excluded: Reanalysis of previous failed matrices beyond this separately approved future evaluation
preservation: C4 closure and Gaussian singleton hold
Shared environments/caches and other users jobs/files
completion: Commit/push, verify remote SHA/SOURCE/artifacts, then mandatory STOP; no real H4 evaluation during preparation
